title: Scaled Graphs
description: Learn scaled bar graphs and line plots for Class 3. Interpret graphs where 1 symbol equals 2, 5, or 10 units. Free online tests and IMO practice.

topics.title: Interpret Scaled Bar Graphs
topics.concept:
In a scaled bar graph, each unit of bar height (or each picture symbol) represents more than one item — such as 2, 5, or 10.

To read: bar value = bar height x scale

Always read the key or label to know the scale.

topics.title: Line Plots with Fractional Units
topics.concept:
A line plot is a graph that shows data points along a number line. Each X represents one data value.

Fractional line plots use number lines with fractions (like 0, 1/4, 1/2, 3/4, 1).

To read: count the X marks above each value.
